priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Immolate is the DoT both Conflagrate and Incinerate need on the target, so it is refreshed the moment it falls off.
Conflagrate consumes part of Immolate's remaining damage as instant burst; only worth casting while Immolate is up.
Shadowburn as the execute finisher below 20 percent target health.

Inert until the engine registers Incinerate (found only in sim/warlock's talent metadata table, no spell registration). Kept as Destruction's signature filler, dealing bonus damage while Immolate is active.
Shadow Bolt is the engine-castable Era filler while Incinerate is inert -- without it this rotation has nothing left to cast once Immolate is up and Conflagrate is on cooldown.
